skills.name: AI & GenAI
skills.description: Production LangGraph multi-agent systems, RAG pipelines, and LLM-driven workflows. Hands-on with GPT-4o, Gemini 2.5, and OpenAI Realtime across 7 shipped products.

skills.name: Backend APIs
skills.description: RESTful and async APIs built for scale — multi-tenant architectures, RBAC, background processing, and clean service-layer separation.

skills.name: Voice & Realtime
skills.description: Production voice agents handling inbound/outbound PSTN calls, appointment booking, and real-time transcription. SIP telephony, session isolation, and sub-200ms latency.

skills.name: Databases
skills.description: Schema design and query optimisation across relational, vector, and in-memory stores. Supabase RLS, Pinecone embeddings, and Redis pub/sub in production.

skills.name: DevOps & Cloud
skills.description: Containerised deployments across AWS, Azure, and GCP. Nginx reverse proxy, SSL, Docker Compose orchestration, and Linux server management.

skills.name: Frontend & Tools
skills.description: Full-stack capable — Next.js dashboards, React SPAs, and TypeScript when the backend story requires a complete product.

projects.name: Staffmind
projects.description: Multi-tenant AI voice agent SaaS with two live products on one backend: a PSTN receptionist that answers calls, books appointments, and syncs Google Calendar in real time, plus "Remi" — an avatar-fronted AI executive assistant that manages Gmail and calendar by voice. Two businesses live in production.

projects.name: Founder's Lab
projects.description: Multi-agent AI co-founder assistant embedded in a client's no-code startup platform. Two independent LangGraph state machines validate business ideas, generate 7-step entrepreneurship roadmaps, run live market research, and generate logo concepts with DALL-E 3.

projects.name: VoxCraft / ReactCraft
projects.description: Client engagement exploring full automation of short-form video. VoxCraft is a self-hosted voice-cloning service with a custom PyTorch wrapper caching per-voice XTTS conditioning embeddings; ReactCraft auto-generates reaction-video commentary — Whisper transcription, GPT-4 scripting, MoviePy caption overlay.

projects.name: StructureIQ
projects.description: AI construction document analyzer for structural engineers. Ingests 50–170+ page PDFs, classifies pages across five firm-specific title-block formats, and extracts hardware, lumber, and concrete specs via GPT-4o Vision and Gemini — enforcing "return empty over guessed" at temperature=0.

projects.name: LexCall
projects.description: AI phone management system for a law firm. ElevenLabs AI answers inbound calls, collects caller information through natural conversation, classifies call type, and auto-generates a branded intake PDF emailed to the firm. Staff dashboard with call recordings, transcripts, and daily analytics. Live at phone.manninglaw.chat.

projects.name: HireIQ
projects.description: AI-driven career discovery platform with voice-driven onboarding — Akira for candidates, Arika for employers — backed by a deterministic OntologyCache and KnowledgeGraph for term/skill matching. Matches against ~414K jobs and ~6,500 companies, surfaces real hiring-team contacts, and tracks outreach end to end.

experience.description: Building production AI systems: multi-tenant voice agent SaaS with LiveKit and OpenAI Realtime API, LangGraph document pipelines, and e-commerce APIs with Django REST Framework and Redis caching. Deployed across AWS, Azure, and GCP with Docker and Nginx.
